description.value: A cross-sectional voxel-based morphometry study comparing gray and white matter tissue density between heavy marijuana users and a non-using comparison group, and examining associations between duration of marijuana use and white matter density.

spans.text: Using voxel-based morphometry, we detected differences in both gray matter and white matter tissue density in a sample of heavy marijuana users compared to a non-using comparison group.
